sequence_notes: Choose one course from three different General concentration categories: Writing, American Literature, British Literature, and Transnational or Multi-Ethnic Literature.
Two additional 300-level English or cross-listed AFN, ASN, or LAT literature courses are required and cannot double-count concentration-category selections.
Two semesters of the same Modern Foreign Language are required. One language course may satisfy World Cultures; ITL 170 and courses taught in English do not qualify.
A Writing Intensive course is required for graduation.
